scenes.narration: Running a lot, but your legs keep getting weaker? Do these five moves twice a week and get stronger without slowing down.

scenes.title: Bulgarian split squat
scenes.narration: Bulgarian split squats. Drop the back knee straight down, keep the front heel planted, and drive up. One leg at a time, just like running.

scenes.title: Romanian deadlift
scenes.narration: Romanian deadlifts. Push your hips back, keep the dumbbells close, and stop when your hamstrings stretch. This protects you from pulls when you sprint.

scenes.title: Kettlebell swing
scenes.narration: Kettlebell swings. Hinge, then snap your hips forward. The bell floats up from your glutes, not your arms.

scenes.title: Box jump
scenes.narration: Box jumps. Jump up, land soft and quiet, step down. Low reps, full rest. This is where your speed comes from.

scenes.title: Single-leg calf raise
scenes.narration: Single leg calf raises. All the way up, three seconds down. Strong calves take the beating of every stride.
